changes.title: Mitch McConnell returns to Capitol Hill after monthslong absence
changes.summary: GOP Sen. Mitch McConnell of Kentucky returned to Capitol Hill on Monday for the first time in three months, ending a prolonged absence that sparked widespread speculation about his health.
